name: W3C DID Methods Working Group (proposed charter)
status: Proposed charter in Advisory Committee review (2026-09-30); public comments invited through 2026-10-28.
relevance: Mission: "to standardize DID Methods that use Web technologies"; a separate maintenance charter for the existing Decentralized Identifier (DID) Working Group (WG), whose mission includes DID Resolution, went into refinement on 2026-08-10 and was sent to the Advisory Committee on 2026-10-07, with public comments invited through 2026-11-05 (see w3c-did-wg).

evidence.read: Charter read in full on 2026-10-02; announcement of 2026-09-30 read on 2026-10-03 and again on 2026-10-13, with the announcements of 2026-08-10 (start of refinement of the DID WG maintenance charter) and 2026-10-07 (proposed DID WG charter sent to the Advisory Committee).
evidence.not_found: Not found in the charter text, 2026-10-02: agent, AI, commerce, merchant, payment, delegat (word stem).
